claims.claim: The checked compiler routes exposed by the milestone refine the source program under State.eq.
The checked tiling family covers ordinary, identity, second-level, diamond, full-diamond, and supported compositions.
Index-set splitting composes with the supported checked optimization routes.
Explicit-current and Pluto-hinted parallel, multiparallel, and vector routes use checked certificates and verified code generation.
The milestone includes checked literal-stride lowering and the documented checked subset of unroll-and-jam post-passes.
The artifact reports the supported Pluto-facing request surface and rejects unsupported combinations before unchecked compilation.

profiles.smoke: Clean bootstrap plus the frozen implementation's smoke artifact check.
profiles.full: Default reviewer gate: clean bootstrap, core regression, full artifact check, and explicit vector-current coverage.
profiles.extended: Full profile plus the live Pluto-backed ISS suite; retained as additional evidence rather than a default gate because of its cost and larger integration surface.

boundaries: Scalar and array storage privatization are not covered by State.eq.
General storage-changing transformations are outside this milestone.
Overlapped/flextended tiling is outside this milestone.
Reduction-aware parallelization and full SIMD semantics are not claimed.
Pluto's optimization heuristics and C/OpenScop text parsers are trusted or unverified components; accepted transformations are checked at the stated semantic boundaries.
